description: This file defines the class CloudStoreImplementation which implements interfaces IStore2 and IConfiguration, managing configuration storage and notification operations within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It contains method declarations for configuring the plugin, registering and unregistering notifications, and CRUD operations on key-value storage.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing storage and configuration interfaces for a cloud store plugin within the WPEFramework, managing notifications and key-value data with support for registration, unregistration, and data access.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the CloudStoreImplementation instance with the provided service shell.

methods.name: uint32_t Register(IStore2::INotification * notification)
methods.description: Registers a notification callback if the internal store object is initialized.

methods.name: uint32_t Unregister(IStore2::INotification * notification)
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback if the internal store object is initialized.

methods.name: uint32_t SetValue(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns,const string & key,const string & value,const uint32_t ttl)
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair within the specified scope and namespace, with an optional TTL, using the internal store object.

methods.name: uint32_t GetValue(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns,const string & key,string & value,uint32_t & ttl)
methods.description: Retrieves a value and its TTL for a given key within the specified scope and namespace.

methods.name: uint32_t DeleteKey(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns,const string & key)
methods.description: Deletes a key within the specified scope and namespace.

methods.name: uint32_t DeleteNamespace(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns)
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace within the specified scope.
